name: codex-discord-presence
description: Publishes privacy-safe Codex lifecycle state to the local DiscordRP beacon.

interface.shortDescription: Publishes Codex activity to the DiscordRP master.
interface.longDescription: Runs local lifecycle hooks that map Codex activity to the privacy-safe DiscordRP beacon protocol. Prompts, file names, paths, commands, and search queries never enter the presence payload.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the current Codex Discord Presence plugin status.
